results.description:
Celebrate the return of the hit Apple Original series Ted Lasso with this exclusive excerpt from the second edition of journalist Trent Crimm’s runaway bestseller The Richmond Way.

When it was first published, former Independent investigative reporter Trent Crimm’s account of AFC Richmond’s remarkable season caused a stir among the team’s many fans and misguided haters. In honor of the book’s second printing, Trent presents a sneak peek of a favorite passage with a "Letter from the Author" that provides bonus insights.

In season 4 of Ted Lasso, the eternally optimistic American coach (Jason Sudeikis) returns to Richmond, this time facing his biggest challenge yet: coaching a second-division women’s football team. As familiar faces return and new ones join the club, relationships deepen and evolve. Together, Ted and the team learn to take bold leaps of faith, embracing opportunities they never imagined possible.

Watch Ted Lasso, now streaming on Apple TV.
